interpretation_limits: Confirmation remains one e089-centered case on one layer and forward.
Padding-aware superiority requires locked out-of-sample model loss, not E1 correlation.
Fixed-aggregate-load structural timing remains unresolved unless the new interval resolves it.
A stopping region requires directly measured low-r residual swaps and an equivalence interval.
Completion-fenced timing includes the end fence; observer effects remain explicit.

matched_aggregate_load_contrast.ci_method: two-sided Student-t interval over four independent process-start means

multiplicity.method: Holm adjustment of two-sided t-test p-values

practical_equivalence_margin.rule: Only an interval wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon] supports practical equivalence; crossing zero alone does not.
